name: const unsafe fn size_of_val_raw < T : ? Sized > (val : * const T) -> usize
rule: If the unsized tail of T is a slice and its dynamic tail length is not 0, calling size_of_val_raw(val) requires the slice tail's length to be an initialized integer.
api: const unsafe fn size_of_val_raw < T : ? Sized > (val : * const T) -> usize
expression: The supplied grammar cannot express whether T has a slice tail or whether its dynamic tail length is nonzero and initialized.
